properties.name: Leicestershire Cares
properties.scope: City and county-wide (Leicester, Leicestershire, Rutland) - not tied to a single ward
properties.notes: Pairs business volunteers with schools/colleges for CV workshops, mock interviews, workplace visits; also runs dedicated projects for care-experienced young people (Powering Up, Joining Up Joining In) and youth justice (Violence Intervention Project). Based at 42 Tower Street, Leicester, LE1 6WT.
